# Missing inputs

> Generated by `tools/` from the inputs in `source/`. Every statement below is backed by assembly metadata, IL, or a supplied export sample.
> Anything that could not be proven from those inputs is marked **Unknown** rather than guessed.

The extractor runs on DLLs alone. These additional inputs would each raise a
specific area's confidence.

| Missing input | What it would unlock |
|---|---|
| `source/exporter/` source or decompiled code | Exporter transformations, deliberately excluded objects, column ordering. |
| `source/importer/` source or decompiled code | Transaction scope, duplicate policy, validation rules, true reconstruction order. |
| A JSON export sample | The shape of BixHelper.ExportJson output, currently Unknown. |
| A `.metaexport` from a different source database or core version | Real format versioning; both current samples share one Source Db. |
| A sample containing forms or workflows | The two normalized-model collections currently marked Unknown. |
| An `.mrt` report template sample | The Stimulsoft side of met_Report.ReportData. |
| A populated `*.exe.config` (not just `.default`) | Real configuration keys and connection-string shape. |
